primary_unit: independent world, not repeated prompt or condition

families.required_behavior: Extract distinct facts with resolvable source spans and entity identity.
Cold process reuses graph knowledge with no prior conversation.
Join sources and apply rules in unseen compositions and depths.
Correct current facts, preserve history and invalidate dependent decisions.
Select relevant capability and bind exact current evidence; reject distractors.
Complete a goal through acquisition, reasoning, action and fresh verification.
Learn unseen semantics or ask a consequential clarification.
Preserve intent, negation and identifiers across EN/DE/FR and Portuguese basics.
Resume after interruption without repeated effects or stale completion.
Ground graph claims in actual visual evidence; transcript is a separate control.
Correction changes action and preserves participant ownership.
Discover, persist, compose and cold-reuse a versioned command skill.

splits.development: new world instances; existing fixtures are development only
splits.validation: separate generator structures, documents, semantics and compositions
splits.sealed: Existing full R1 exam; no tuning against sealed worlds

aggregation: Report family counts and uncertainty; absent families remain unmeasured.
unknown_semantics: A new executable name with known effect descriptions is syntax novelty only.
